name: Needle Touch
description: Prick a wound with a needle of qi to stitch the flesh of an ally or the self in one quick motion.

name: Linen Wrap
description: Wind a bandage of qi round a limb so it presses and mends the hurt of an ally or the self.

name: Pressure Sense
description: Feel the pressure of blood under the skin to find an internal bleed that shows no mark.

name: Linen Guard
description: Spread a cloth-like layer of qi over a bandaged ally to turn away a fresh cut.

name: Restful Mending
description: Mend a wound while the patient sleeps by laying slow qi over it through the whole night.

name: Clearing Draw
description: Draw a lingering curse residue or taint out of an ally or the self and disperse it into the air.

name: Resolute Mending
description: Lock the healer's qi into one unbroken repair of a grievous wound and hold it until an ally or the self has set.

name: Rallying Restoration
description: Close the hurts of a worn ally and flood the limbs with fresh vigour so the ally rises and fights on.

name: Heartbeat Sense
description: Listen through the chest wall for the faintest heartbeat of a collapsed ally to learn if any life is left.

name: Chest Rub
description: Rub warm qi into the breastbone to loosen a seized chest and bring a stalled breath back to an ally.

name: Rousing Pinch
description: Pinch a pressure point and spark the nerves with qi to wake a swooning ally to the edge of waking.

name: Stilling Hold
description: Cradle a dying ally in a still pocket of qi so that no movement or blow can hasten the end.

name: Pulse Rekindle
description: Coax a failing heart to beat again with rhythmic bursts of qi felt through the chest of an ally.

name: Heart Jolt
description: Send one sharp pulse of qi through the chest to restart a heart that has just fluttered and stopped.

name: Air Return
description: Breathe qi into the lungs of a drowned or smothered ally until the chest rises of its own accord.

name: Recalling Pulse
description: Call back an ally whose pulse stopped moments ago by driving a burst of qi into the heart before the window of life closes.

name: Anchoring Breath
description: Hold a fading life in the body of a barely breathing ally with a steady stream of breath and qi until it holds alone.

name: Halo Touch
description: Wrap a hand in a faint halo of qi and press it to a wound so the glow sinks in and closes the hurt.

name: Aura Sense
description: Spread the senses across the qi field round the body to find every wounded ally within arm's reach.

name: Wide Warmth
description: Let the warmth of healing qi flow out beyond the body to ease the aches of allies standing near.

name: Lingering Calm
description: Leave a soft calm hanging in the qi round a frightened ally so the fear loosens and does not return.

name: Closing Balm
description: Pour qi into the living field round the healer so that shallow wounds of nearby allies close together.

name: Spreading Salve
description: Release a soft wave of qi from the healer outward that salves the bruises and cuts of every ally it passes.

name: Cradle Balm
description: Hold a wide field of healing qi round the healer so every wounded ally standing in it mends steadily.

name: Easing Tide
description: Gather qi and spread it as one great calm over the near ranks to ease pain and restore breath in all of them.

name: Stain Sense
description: Trace the faint stain of a foreign qi through the flesh of a patient to find where the taint has settled.

name: Scour Touch
description: Scour a scabbed wound with fine qi so only clean flesh remains on an ally or the self.

name: Taint Screen
description: Hold a screen of clean qi between the healer and a tainted patient so the foulness cannot cross.

name: Pure Breath
description: Breathe clean qi into the lungs of a fouled ally so the air in the chest runs clear.

name: Fouling Ease
description: Soothe the sickness a taint leaves in the gut and head of an ally or the self.

name: Rot Purge
description: Burn the creeping rot out of a festering wound with bright qi so the flesh of an ally or the self is left sound.

name: Curse Unravel
description: Find the knot at the heart of a curse on an ally or the self and pick it loose thread by thread.

name: Backlash Settle
description: Draw the scorching backlash of a failed technique out of the meridians of an ally or the self and let it cool.

name: Thorough Purification
description: Pass the full body of an ally or the self through a slow deep cleansing that lifts taint and lingering poison from every meridian.

name: Cleansing Tide
description: Release a rolling tide of bright qi that washes the taint from every ally in the near ranks at once.

name: Paired Touch
description: Lay both palms on a wound and let two flows of qi meet in the middle so it closes cleanly on an ally.

name: Paired Wrist
description: Read the pulse at both wrists of a patient at once to learn which side of the body is the weaker.

name: Mirrored Press
description: Press matched points on either side of a swollen joint to draw the swelling out of an ally or the self.

name: Twin Shield
description: Open a plate of qi in each hand and guard the patient from two sides while the healer works.

name: Dual Mending
description: Mend a deep wound from both edges at once so the flesh of an ally or the self meets in the centre.

name: Twin Rinse
description: Pour clean qi into a poisoned limb with one hand while drawing the fouled qi out with the other.

name: Twinned Restoration
description: Restore two wounded allies at once with a hand on each so the healer's qi runs through both in step.

name: Echoing Renewal
description: Let a mending flow from one patient's body into the next so a restored ally lends the glow to a companion.

name: Keen Sense
description: Sharpen the senses to a point and pick the hidden fault out of a body at a single look.

name: Practised Hand
description: Close a wound in one sure sweep of the hand without a wasted pulse of qi on an ally or the self.

name: Swift Stitch
description: Throw a line of qi across a gap in the flesh and pull it taut so the edges of an ally join.

name: Wing Shield
description: Spread a pair of broad vanes of qi over a patient to turn back a falling blow.

name: Keen Cleanse
description: Spot a single fleck of taint in a body and strike it out with a needle-thin line of qi.

name: Winged Mend
description: Leap over the heads of the crowd to a fallen ally and land with a healing pulse already in the hands.

name: Distant Ribbon
description: Send a ribbon of healing qi across a short gap to mend an ally the healer cannot touch.

name: Watchful Restoration
description: Keep a ribbon of qi fixed on a grievously wounded ally and adjust it with every breath until the body holds.
first_area: Chapter 004 — The Measure of a Gift (Ref: 1.1.1.004)

name: Unerring Purge
description: Pick out each speck of poison or curse in the blood of an ally and wash them all away at once.

name: Cupped Warmth
description: Gather warm qi as water in the cupped palms and pour it slowly over the wound of an ally or the self.

name: Rill Touch
description: Let a thin rill of qi run from fingertip to wound and carry the ache away from an ally or the self.

name: Pool Sense
description: Lay still qi over a patient like the face of a pool and watch the ripples reveal each hidden wound.

name: Ripple Ease
description: Send widening ripples of calm through the flesh of a battered ally to loosen the bruising.

name: Renewing Current
description: Run a steady river of healing qi through a long-wounded limb until its stiff tissues soften and renew.

name: Gathered Tide
description: Draw healing qi in from the healer's whole frame into one tide and pour it into a drained ally.

name: Overflowing Restoration
description: Let a brimming basin of qi spill over a body broken by many wounds until each one has closed.

name: Cascade Revival
description: Loose a cascade of stored qi into the chest of an ally who has just stopped breathing to start life again.

name: Breeze Touch
description: Pass a hand over a hurt on a breath of cooling qi so the pain of an ally or the self lifts.

name: Gust Sense
description: Send a gust of qi across the wounded to feel which of them are failing and which will last.

name: Breeze Veil
description: Keep a moving curtain of air round a patient to carry off dust and stinging spray.

name: Airy Ease
description: Lighten a sore body with cool air-borne qi until the aches of an ally or the self drift away.

name: Clearing Gust
description: Blow a sharp clean gust through a body and sweep out the fouled qi that clings to the skin of an ally.

name: Wind Mend
description: Spiral healing qi round a wounded limb on the wind until the tissue of an ally or the self draws in.

name: Swift Rally
description: Sweep a quickening wind of qi through a flagging ally to put strength back into the legs.

name: Oath Restoration
description: Pour the full strength of a sworn healer's qi into a wounded ally and refuse to stop until the wound is sealed.

name: Sworn Revival
description: Stake the healer's own reserve on calling back a fresh casualty whose pulse has only just gone.

name: Spread Palm
description: Show an open palm over the wound and let a clear flow of qi pass from it into an ally or the self.

name: Broad Sense
description: Open the senses wide and take in the state of every wounded ally within a few paces.

name: Sky Veil
description: Throw a pale veil of qi overhead to turn aside falling grit and loose shot from the wounded.

name: Free Breath
description: Open the airways of a choking ally with spreading qi until each breath comes deep and free.

name: Daylight Touch
description: Press a hand of warm bright qi onto a wound and watch the colour flush back into the skin.

name: Open Mending
description: Mend a wound in plain sight by pouring qi in a wide clean beam that all can see.

name: Skylit Cleanse
description: Hold a hand up as a lens of bright qi and burn the taint out of the body of an ally.

name: Unhindered Rally
description: Clear every clog from the qi channels of a faltering ally so strength runs through unimpeded.

name: Open Hand Revival
description: Spread the hand over the chest of an ally whose life has just left and call it back with one wide pulse of qi.

name: Boundless Mending
description: Pour unrestrained qi into a body broken in many places and let the whole of it knit together at once.

name: Sworn Touch
description: Make a sworn healer's touch on the wound of an ally or the self that closes it with a steady pulse of qi.

name: Sworn Reading
description: Hold the oath in mind and let qi find the worst of the wounded among the fallen first.

name: Tireless Breath
description: Share the healer's own steady breathing with an ally and lend the lungs a second wind.

name: Mender's Plate
description: Raise a hard plate of qi at the healer's arm as a sworn guard that stands between healer and blow.

name: Pledged Mending
description: Pledge the mending to the end and keep qi flowing into a wound until the ally can stand.

name: Tireless Hand
description: Work wound after wound along a line of casualties without lifting the hand or losing the beat of the qi.

name: Oath Recall
description: Keep the oath and call a freshly fallen ally back from the edge of death in one great gather of qi.

name: Tireless Restoration
description: Spend the healer's reserve freely across a whole night so every wounded ally brought in is made whole by dawn.
